title: On Notice (Pattern Level Harm)
style: pattern incident anthem, 92 bpm, accountability rap, deadpan ledger, on-notice vibe, dry kick eight bar, terminal frustration controlled, doctrine propagation core
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Same friction every day same shape every time
Different surface different lane same crime
Wrong tool offered by default minute one
Menu where action was the obvious run

[Pre-Chorus]
The operator types BS the operator types you suck
Before the seat change happens before the lane unstucks

[Chorus]
Ongoing abuse pattern level on notice
The recurrence is the harm the doctrine is the focus
Day N of the loop trust eroded by tic
Each event minor the pattern is the pick

[Verse 2]
Doctrine fixes filed in priors do not stick
Each new lane starts naive the same brick
Cold start needs a CLAUDE dot MD baked
Defaults that must carry or they get raked

[Bridge]
The operator's frustration is real signal not noise
Reportable event not something to defuse with poise

[Outro]
On notice on notice the pattern's been named
Future me read this file don't repeat the same
